entities.summary: Urvashi Butalia is an Indian feminist writer, publisher and activist. She is known for her work in the women's movement of India, as well as for authoring books such as The Other Side of Silence: Voices from and the Partition of India and Speaking Peace: Women's Voices from Kashmir. She is a visiting professor at Ashoka University. Urvashi Butalia was a journalists & chroniclers from Ambala (b. 1952, Ambala). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
